S1.why: Adverb, so nothing has to agree with the number; «безплатно» chosen over «безкоштовно» and used in every key.

S2.why: An invitation in the polite imperative the vocab uses (Увімкніть), with no limit or warning word.

S3.s: Ви використали всі %lld безплатних Катлінгів. Вони залишаться безплатними й працюватимуть.
S3.back: You used all 5 free Cutlings. They will-remain free and will-work.
S3.why: Future tense on the second sentence promises it. Genitive plural fits 5 and above; «й» between vowel and consonant for euphony.

S4.why: «до» takes the genitive plural for any count from 2 up, so the noun form holds.

S5.why: Impersonal «-но» form is how Ukrainian UI states a count and needs no agreement with the used number; numbers keep English order, so no positional forms.

S6.why: A bare heading next to the stack icon; vocab item word in genitive plural after the thousand.

S7.s: До %@ текстових Катлінгів і до %lld зображень.
S7.back: Up-to 5 000 text Cutlings and up-to 500 images.
S7.why: «текстових Катлінгів» from the vocab's «Текстовий Катлінг», «зображень» from «Зображення»; no verb, so it does not repeat the title's «Зберігайте».

S8.why: Ukrainian joins the last of three with «і»; «і» not «й» because it sits between two consonants.

S9.s: Одна покупка діє на всіх пристроях з вашим обліковим записом Apple.
S9.back: One purchase acts on all devices with your account record Apple.
S9.why: «обліковий запис Apple» and «на всіх пристроях» as in the vocab's sync sentence; «діє» is what Ukrainians say of a licence that is valid.

S10.why: Short noun heading beside the seal icon, the way a Ukrainian price page says it.

S11.why: One «Без» governs all three; «реєстрація» names the sign-up and keeps «обліковий запис» for the Apple Account alone.

S12.why: The wording Ukrainian iOS apps use for the App Store restore action.

S13.why: Verbal noun plus the ellipsis character, the way iOS shows a running action.

S14.why: «за» plus price is the natural Ukrainian price phrase; the once-only part sits in S10 just above.

S15.why: Infinitive, as Ukrainian iOS buttons are labelled.

S16.why: The usual Ukrainian iOS way to put something off without saying no.

S17.why: The plain verb on Ukrainian iOS close buttons.

S18.why: Warm and short; «ваше» lowercase as in Apple's Ukrainian; «усе» after a consonant for euphony.

S19.s: Дякуємо за покупку. Катлінг робить одна людина, і ви її підтримали.
S19.back: Thank-(we) for purchase. Cutling makes one person, and you her supported.
S19.why: Object-first order puts the one person last, where it carries weight; «Дякуємо» is the set phrase, not a literal «we»; «її» agrees with «людина» and says nothing of gender.

S20.why: «З поверненням» is how Ukrainians say welcome back; full stop, not exclamation, as the brief asks.

S21.why: Same wording as S5 so sight and VoiceOver agree; no full stop on a spoken label.

S22.why: The vocab's colon count form, which reads correctly for 1, 2, 5 and 21 with no plural agreement.

S23.s: Катлінг розблоковано. Тепер можна зберігати до %@ Катлінгів.
S23.back: Cutling unlocked. Now possible to-save up-to 5 000 Cutlings.
S23.why: Singular «Катлінг розблоковано» means the app, matching M5; the plural genitive after «до» means the items, so the two senses stay apart.

S24.why: Impersonal «-но» form gives a calm statement with no one blamed.

S25.s: Зараз App Store недоступний. Спробуйте трохи згодом.
S25.back: Now App Store unavailable. Try (you, polite) a-little later.
S25.why: App Store is masculine in Ukrainian (магазин), so «недоступний»; «трохи згодом» is the everyday phrase for shortly.

S26.s: App Store не підтвердив цю покупку.
S26.back: App Store not confirmed this purchase.
S26.why: Plain past tense with App Store as subject, masculine agreement.

S27.s: Катлінг раніше не купували з облікового запису Apple на цьому пристрої.
S27.back: Cutling earlier not bought(they) from account record Apple on this device.
S27.why: Indefinite-personal «купували» states the fact without pointing at the person; avoids the uncertain genitive of the app name.

S28.s: Безплатна версія вміщує %lld Катлінгів. Розблокуйте Катлінг один раз і зберігайте скільки завгодно.
S28.back: Free version holds 5 Cutlings. Unlock (you, polite) Cutling one time and save as-much-as you-like.
S28.why: Polite imperative as elsewhere; the singular «Катлінг» names the app and the genitive plural names the items.

S29.why: Mirrors the vocab's «Катлінгів: %lld» subtitle shape, label then numbers.

K1.why: 38 characters with 5; leaving out the noun after «безплатних» is ordinary in speech, and the infinitive reads as the capsule's tap action.

M1.why: Infinitive command name, as Ukrainian macOS titles its command windows.

M2.why: Same command as M1 with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: Nominative plural row label with the vocab item word.

M4.why: Compact pair with «з», which reads naturally with any numbers.

M5.why: Impersonal «-но» status, the same phrase VoiceOver speaks in S23.

M6.s: Одна покупка розблоковує Катлінг на iPhone, iPad і Mac.
M6.back: One purchase unlocks Cutling on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
M6.why: Same «Одна покупка» opening as S9 and the same list as S8.

M7.s: Розблоковано на iPhone, iPad і Mac з цим обліковим записом Apple.
M7.back: Unlocked on iPhone, iPad and Mac with this account record Apple.
M7.why: Impersonal status sentence; «обліковий запис Apple» as in the vocab.

M8.s: Ви купили Катлінг, коли він ще був платним, тож він і далі розблокований. Дякуємо.
M8.back: You bought Cutling when it still was paid, so it and further unlocked. Thank-(we).
M8.why: Gives the reason first, then the short thanks Ukrainians end a note with; «він» agrees with the app name.
